verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms that @babylonjs/core is published on npm under the Apache-2.0 license, which permits reading, modifying and redistributing the engine. The official docs also describe Babylon.js as an 'open game and rendering engine'. The core of the story is delivered by a permissive open-source license, but the pack never shows how a developer would actually get at and change the full source. Missing for 10: evidence of a public source repository, build-from-source or fork-and-patch documentation, and independent hands-on reports of developers modifying engine internals.
